title: Autonomous agents for electricity-system planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning electricity systems requires repeated decisions that connect regional resources, investment, operation and network constraints. Here we present an autonomous planning framework that carries prepared regional scenarios through proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign and final plan selection. Agents propose investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions, interpret numerical feedback, and decide how to revise designs and when to stop. The framework automatically executes annual investment-and-dispatch optimization and representative-feeder verification, applies fixed acceptance criteria and retains the lowest-cost accepted candidate. We evaluate forty carbon-constrained trajectories across ten system-year scenarios in five electricity systems and four countries, using two model deployments and single- and multi-agent architectures. translated_title: 面向电力系统规划的自主智能体
translated_abstract: 规划电力系统需要反复进行将区域资源、投资、运行和网络约束联系起来的决策。在此，我们提出了一个自主规划框架，该框架将准备好的区域情景依次推进至提案、数值评估、反馈解读、重新设计和最终方案选择环节。智能体提出投资边界、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施，解读数值反馈，并决定如何修改设计以及何时停止。该框架自动执行年度投资与调度优化以及代表性馈线验证，应用固定的验收标准，并保留成本最低的通过验收的候选方案。我们在五个电力系统、四个国家中，使用两种模型部署以及单智能体和多智能体架构，评估了跨越十个系统年情景的四十条碳约束轨迹。全部四十次运行均保留了满足实现……的候选方案（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于电力系统规划的自主智能体框架，能够自动完成从方案提案、数值评估、反馈解读到重新设计和最终方案选择的全流程决策，并自动保留成本最低的可行规划方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an autonomous agent framework for electricity-system planning that automates the full decision loop of proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign, and final plan selection, retaining the lowest-cost feasible candidate.
